boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Documented Queens-campus places for studying, meeting, reflection, and student connection.

cards.title: Work from the Main Library
cards.subtitle: St. Augustine Hall, Queens campus
cards.notes: Set up a solo session in a quiet study room or bring classmates to a large group table; use the library’s Wi-Fi for research and shared documents.
cards.short_summary: The Main Library supports both quiet work and collaborative study.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s identifies St. Augustine Hall as its main library and describes quiet study rooms, group tables, and Wi-Fi for individual and collaborative study.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Places to Study on and near St. John’s Queens, NY, Campus
cards.access_notes: Library services and access can vary by university status and academic calendar; check current library information before visiting.

cards.title: Meet at the D’Angelo Center
cards.subtitle: Queens-campus student-life center
cards.notes: Use the DAC as a central meeting point between classes, then move into an available lounge or scheduled room when your group needs more focus.
cards.short_summary: A student-life center with computer labs, classrooms, dining, and a campus living room.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s says the D’Angelo Center includes smart classrooms, computer labs, a food court, and its campus living room.
cards.access_notes: Some rooms and facilities may be student-only or reserved for events; follow posted access guidance.

cards.title: Pause in the DAC Living Room Lounge
cards.subtitle: Second floor, D’Angelo Center
cards.notes: Bring your charger and use this named second-floor lounge to regroup, read, or catch up with classmates between commitments on campus.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor D’Angelo Center lounge listed among commuter resources.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s lists the DAC Living Room Lounge, located on the second floor of the D’Angelo Center, as a commuter resource.
cards.access_notes: Listed as a commuter resource; confirm current access and event use before visiting.

cards.title: Make DAC 100 your between-class stop
cards.subtitle: D’Angelo Center commuter lounge
cards.notes: Use DAC 100 when you need a documented place to study or rest between classes; arrive with your materials so you can use a short gap well.
cards.short_summary: A named commuter lounge for studying or resting between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s lists DAC 100: Commuter Lounge Area among resources for commuters needing a place to study or rest between classes.
cards.access_notes: Listed for commuter students; verify current availability with Campus Activities.

cards.title: Coordinate plans at DAC 128
cards.subtitle: D’Angelo Center multipurpose room
cards.notes: Check availability before gathering here. Use the named multipurpose room for a planned group check-in, with a backup location ready if it is reserved.
cards.short_summary: A named multipurpose room included in the University’s commuter-resource list.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s lists DAC 128: Multipurpose Room as one of the commuter resources available around the Queens campus.
cards.access_notes: Room use may be affected by reservations or programming; confirm availability before relying on it.

cards.title: Find the Sodano Coffee House
cards.subtitle: DAC 314, D’Angelo Center
cards.notes: Add DAC 314 to your campus plan when you need a named indoor stop, and check current room use before settling in for a work session.
cards.short_summary: Sodano Coffee House is a named D’Angelo Center commuter resource.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s lists DAC 314 Sodano Coffee House among commuter resources available around campus.
cards.access_notes: Listed as a commuter resource; confirm current access and scheduled use before visiting.

cards.title: Connect through the Student Engagement Resource Center
cards.subtitle: DAC 125, D’Angelo Center
cards.notes: Stop by DAC 125 to ask about involvement opportunities or connect with other students; use the posted hours when planning your visit.
cards.short_summary: A D’Angelo Center hub for students to gather, connect, and learn about campus involvement.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s describes the Student Engagement Resource Center in DAC 125 as a hub where students, particularly commuters, can gather and connect.
cards.access_notes: The page lists hours as Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–7 p.m. and Friday 9 a.m.–3 p.m.; confirm changes before visiting.

cards.title: Use the Great Lawn for an outdoor regroup
cards.subtitle: In front of St. Augustine Hall
cards.notes: Choose a visible lawn edge as your meeting point, then use the outdoor seating, tables, or shaded areas for a daylight study break with classmates.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus space with seating, tables, shade, and Wi-Fi described for study.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s describes the Great Lawn, in front of St. Augustine Hall, as having lawn seating, tables, shaded areas, and outdoor Wi-Fi for solo or group study.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Places to Study on and near St. John’s Queens, NY, Campus
cards.access_notes: Outdoor use is weather-dependent and may be affected by campus programming.

cards.title: Visit St. Thomas More Church
cards.subtitle: Queens-campus church and Campus Ministry gathering place
cards.notes: Use the church for private reflection or join a listed worship or music-ministry activity; check the current semester schedule before you go.
cards.short_summary: The campus church hosts worship, prayer, music ministry, and reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s identifies St. Thomas More Church as its Queens-campus church and lists daily Mass, a student Mass, prayer, and choir activity there.
cards.access_notes: The University states the church is open daily from 7:30 a.m. to 10 p.m.; services follow the posted schedule.

cards.title: Locate the Health Education Resource Center
cards.subtitle: St. Augustine Hall, Queens campus
cards.notes: Use HERC as a named library destination when health-education resources fit your work, and contact the University Libraries for current service details.
cards.short_summary: A Queens-campus library destination within the University Libraries system.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s lists the Health Education Resource Center (HERC) as a Queens-campus library and provides a 3D map for HERC in St. Augustine Hall.
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours, access rules, and HERC availability before visiting.
